prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Monochrome Signal: page #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #494949, secondary surface #E8E8E8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Work Sans and reading text in Work Sans; single-family hierarchy through weight and size. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 16px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
